name: @w6w-apps/vbout
description: VBOUT marketing automation: contact lists, contacts, tags, email campaigns, social channels and goals.

w6w.longDescription:
VBOUT is an all-in-one digital marketing platform: email marketing, marketing automation, social media publishing, landing pages and a CRM-style contact timeline. This app drives its REST API from a workflow, centred on the email-marketing surface.

Manage contact lists, create, update, sync, move and delete contacts (with list custom fields), tag contacts, record custom timeline activities and read a contact's timeline. Read email campaigns and their open, bounce, unsubscribe and click statistics, audiences and email templates, plus connected social channels, social link statistics and conversion goals.

Authentication is a single VBOUT API key, sent as the key query parameter by the host so a workflow never handles it. Health checks cover API reachability and credential validity; VBOUT publishes no status page and no usage endpoint, and both are declared as such.
